verdict.rationale: Lovable explicitly documents turning a published app into an MCP server that ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants can connect to, including configuring tools, sign-in, permissions, and access — directly satisfying the 'connect an agent via an official MCP server' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of this MCP server working in practice, and more detail on the scope of exposed tools/capabilities beyond first-party docs.
